guide.title: Udhaar kaise kaam karta hai
guide.subtitle: Do cheezein yaad rakhein: aapki jeb aur aapki copy
guide.intro: Khata do alag cheezein sambhalta hai. Aapki jeb mein asli paise hote hain. Copy sirf likhti hai ke kis ne kis ko dena hai.
guide.pocketHint: Jo cash aap ke paas hai

guide.youOwe: Aap ne un ko dene hain
guide.ruleSign: Har row par + (hara) ka matlab paise jeb mein aaye aur - ka matlab nikle.
guide.ruleCards: Net, Get aur Give cards aur Aap ne diya / Aap ko mila tabs aap ki copy ko follow karte hain.
guide.ruleForgive: Maaf wahid surat hai jab koi paisa nahi hilta. Sirf copy badalti hai.

guide.title: Backup aur Restore
guide.subtitle: Apna khata mehfooz rakhein aur naye phone mein le jayein
guide.intro: Backup aap ke khata ki ek chhoti si copy hai, ek file mein, jaise copy ki photo.
guide.step1: Backup lein dabayein aur file kisi mehfooz jagah bhejein: Google Drive, Files, ya WhatsApp (apne aap ko).
guide.step2: Naye phone mein ye screen kholein aur Restore karein dabayein. Apni save ki hui file chunein.
guide.step3: Restore sirf wo cheezein add karta hai jo maujood nahi. Ye maujooda cheezein kabhi delete ya replace nahi karta, is liye do baar restore karna bhi mehfooz hai.
guide.step4: Wahi file web dashboard mein bhi chalti hai. Phone ka backup aap ka Udhaar aur parties rakhta hai.
guide.note: Demo data sirf practice ke liye hai, is liye uska backup nahi hota.
